notes.title: Small terrain update
notes.notes: Tweaked the terrain at the start of the game to make it more clear for new players that they need to climb, not just wall jump.

notes.title: Music update
notes.notes:
Swapped in revised music tracks by Nick Powell.

Soundtrack coming soon!

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.notes:
Patch notes below:
[list]
[*] honey effect now applies to phantom balls
[*] fixed a bug where mulligans got stuck on terrain if the player blocks them on the edge of a cliff. this can still occur but is less likely, and they can be unstuck by blocking.
[*] terrain tweaks to prevent egregious cheese
[*] cheese wedge is slightly more powerful
[*] clarified some dialogue text
[*] enabled steam screenshots using the f12 hotkey
[*] changed the tee box next to hole 14 to show the correct par (5)
[*] fixed premature mulligan achievements
[*] fixed bug in ending dialogue
[/list]
